title: Reservation fragmentation forecast & spillover plan — weekly export
summary: Weekly exported sheet that combines observed per-cluster/pool utilization with a short-term forecast of reservation fragmentation and expected spillover into burst pools. Intended for on-call/ops and capacity planners to decide short-term reserve shifts and preemptible caps.

interpretation_notes:
Observations: 1) Fragmentation spikes correlate with bursts of many small dev/preemptible jobs that leave single-GPU leftovers inside reserved pools. 2) prod-large pools show highest sustained util_pct but still have non-trivial fragmentation when reserved_gpus are misaligned with common request sizes (8/16/32). 3) dev-preempt pools are frequent sources of spillover into shared-burst during evening windows.

Immediate recommendations: - Shift 8 GPUs of reserve from prod-small (cluster-sfo-02) to shared-burst for next 72 hours to reduce projected_spill_gpus during evening microbursts (owner: Ravi, deadline: 2026-06-06). - Add a short-lived bin-packing job step to coalesce small dev jobs before placement to reduce fragment_pct (owner: Lina, deadline: 2026-06-11). - Temporarily increase preemptible cap in cluster-ams-01 by 10% to allow better absorb of tail jobs and avoid cross-region spill (owner: Marta, deadline: 2026-06-07).

Longer-term actions: - Evaluate right-sizing reservation buckets to align with 1/2/4/8/16 GPU request distributions observed in the 90-day job histogram; target is to reduce average fragment_pct by 6 points. - Instrument per-request request_size on placement logs and add alert when fragment_pct > 18% for a pool for 3 consecutive days.

Questions/open items: - We think KV-cache warmups are increasing short-lived peak demand; can models team add a warmup endpoint to smooth traffic? (ping: @models-team) - Is there any upcoming customer rollout requiring guaranteed latency next week that would make recommended shifting infeasible?

Action items summary: - Reserve shift (Ravi) 2026-06-06 - Dev bin-pack PoC (Lina) 2026-06-11 - Preempt cap bump (Marta) 2026-06-07 - Follow-up review: 2026-06-12 (infra ops sync)
raw_notes:
Quick dump from dashboard export + adhoc notes. Removed precise user ids for privacy. Use this as operational input; not final capacity plan. Links: CON-7421 has the 90-day job-size histogram; JIRA-INFRA-1983 tracks the bin-pack PoC.

Parsing hints: fragment_pct computed as (1 - floor(active_gpus / reserved_gpus)) * 100 for per-reserve-unit granularity then smoothed. projected_spill_gpus derived from recent 3-day 95th percentile spike minus available burst headroom.

Contact: Avery Chen (owners@redwood.ai) for questions or to request a diff against the nightly capacity export.
